ecole.name: L'école : la salle de classe · School: the Classroom
ecole.alt: The village classroom painted in ink and gouache: the teacher reads standing on a blue mattress, a crayfish holds chalk, a sun in glasses gives a lesson at an easel, Monsieur Verbe listens to a white dove, reads with a prawn and bursts through a finish ribbon, a chalkboard on its own table with the alphabet chalked on it, a goldfish pinning a card to the notice board, a globe with blue Jell-O, a young doe with a sack on her back and an exercise book folded into a kayak; an open green door on the left leads to the school garden, a half-open wooden door at the back shows the red curtains of the school theater and a teal door on the right leads to the math classroom.

doors.label: La classe de maths
doors.hint: Through the teal door to the math classroom

doors.label: Le théâtre de l'école
doors.hint: Through the half-open wooden door to the school theater

doors.label: Le jardin de l'école
doors.hint: Through the open green door to the school garden

zooms.label: la trousse
zooms.hint: Open the pencil case on the desk

zooms.label: le tableau
zooms.hint: Look closely at the alphabet on the blackboard

items.scene: The fat blue pencil case on the desk waves its little white flag of TRUCE.
Monsieur Verbe (red beret) leans out of the window, a hand cupped by his ear, listening to the white dove.

trousse.name: La trousse · Pencil Case
trousse.alt: Close-up of the desk with the open blue pencil case: a ruler with a crown and red cape, a collie puppy with its paw stuck to a glue bottle, a pink eraser in a silver gum wrapper, a pencil in a rainbow crayon wrapper and scissors riding a tiny wooden seesaw.

maths.name: La classe de maths · Math Class
maths.alt: The math classroom painted in ink and gouache: a pyramid peering through a spyglass, a star wrapped in a towel, a ball in a blue bowl on a stool, a red arrow in a target with a lightning flash, Monsieur Verbe adding a giraffe to a toy zoo, dividing a pizza in goggles and flippers and measuring a tall sunflower, the teacher's desk in front, an orange hoop, a musical triangle, a smiling ice cube, a big abacus with a toy bull on top and a blue square driving a red toy car; the open door on the left leads back to the classroom and the open garden door at the back leads out to the playground.

doors.label: L'école
doors.hint: Back through the door to the classroom

doors.label: La cour de récré
doors.hint: Go out through the garden door to the playground

zooms.label: le pupitre
zooms.hint: Look at what is on the teacher's desk

pupitre.name: Le pupitre · Desk
pupitre.alt: Close-up of the teacher's desk in the math classroom: a purple line leaning on a little tightrope, half an orange in a bow tie, a slate with a sum drawn in chalk dots, a compass drawing a circle, a die in sunglasses holding up the sun and a golden sheaf of wheat with a tag of counting marks.

recre.name: La cour de récré · Playground
recre.alt: The sunny school playground painted in ink and gouache: twins in yellow dresses shrugging, a girl juggling six balls by a red see-saw, a farmer boy carrying eight sheaves of wheat on a pole (four on each side), a van with twenty crates in five rows of four, a tennis girl with seven balls in a row by her tipped-over basket, a toy boat sunk in a pond with five ducks, a mother cat with three kittens, a boy throwing three beanbags at a hoop, a boy pushing away a stack of nine pancakes, a girl holding up ten fingers, and in the bottom-left corner a little school fair with two striped stalls, a tombola wheel and a family walking up; the green door on the left leads back to the math class.

doors.label: La classe de maths
doors.hint: Back through the green door to the math class

zooms.label: la kermesse
zooms.hint: Walk over to the school fair

kermesse.name: La kermesse · School Fair
kermesse.alt: The school fair painted in ink and gouache: families stroll between three striped stalls; an empty nest sits on the blue book stall roof, which holds nineteen books (ten above, nine below); a plush cat with a lit torch sits on the red candy stall roof, with eighteen wrapped candies in three rows of six beside an empty jar; the orange stall has a big oozing cheese and twelve slices; in front are a pyramid of fifteen cans, a tray of fifteen dice with two more stacked on top, and thirteen trays standing in a row; at the front a foosball game with eleven little players, a green parrot on its perch, a tombola wheel, a girl running with a windmill and spilled popcorn; the green door on the left leads back to the playground.

doors.label: La cour de récré
doors.hint: Back through the green door to the playground

theatre.name: Le théâtre de l'école · School Theater
theatre.alt: The school theater painted in ink and gouache: under bunting and spotlights a little diva in pink sings la-la-la, a boy lugs a big sack over his shoulder, a girl in a grass skirt wears many flower leis and a striped strongman lifts a huge iron weight; in front of the stage a child dressed as the Wizard of Oz in a green robe points to a row of little painted doors, a mime holds up one finger, a girl in pink holds up one giant wooden spoon and a boy hugs his teddy; a model village with a river, boats and a cathedral sits on a table on the left, rows of chairs face the stage, costumes hang on a rail the open door on the right leads back to the classroom and the open garden door on the left, by the bookcase, looks out onto the sports field and its red running track; an arch on the far left opens onto the school library's bookshelves and an arch on the far right onto the fête courtyard with its maypole and bunting.

doors.label: L'école
doors.hint: Back through the open door to the classroom

doors.label: Le terrain de sport
doors.hint: Through the open garden door to the sports field

doors.label: La bibliothèque
doors.hint: Through the arch on the left to the school library

doors.label: La fête de l'école
doors.hint: Through the arch on the right to the school fête

zooms.label: la maquette
zooms.hint: Look closely at the model village on the table

maquette.name: La maquette · The Model Village
maquette.alt: Close-up of the model village on the theater table: two boys hold up their shiny fishing lures, a boy pushes his toy sailing ship along the river, a rowing boat waits with its oar, a little girl points at the model cathedral, a girl holds a bunch of daisies and a boy catches dew drops from a big leaf in his cup; tiny houses, a bridge, a street lamp and trees all around.

terrain.name: Le terrain de sport · Sports Field
terrain.alt: The school sports field painted in ink and gouache, ringed by a red running track: a big white van with twenty footballs on its roof rack in two rows of ten; a red toy train pulling three wagons, each heaped with ten yellow balls; a girl at a wooden table laid with four rows of ten carrots, a big black ant on the grass in front of it; a wooden boat on a round pond carrying five crates of ten red apples, an ant on top of its mast; a white swan at the back corner of a sandpit laid with six rows of ten white shells; a ginger cat beside four little white vans, each with twenty orange balls on its roof rack in four rows of five; children watching and playing; the white garden gate on the left leads back to the school theater.

doors.label: Le théâtre
doors.hint: Back through the garden door to the theater

jardin.name: Le jardin de l'école · School Garden
jardin.alt: The school garden painted in ink and gouache, a green lawn criss-crossed by brick paths: a moustached chef waves from the door of his little red-roofed hut; a girl in orange overalls hides among three palms in wicker baskets; an old golfer in a flat cap putts his ball through a wire hoop on a putting green; a boy in board shorts stands on a wooden crate beside his surfboard; a girl dances inside her red hula hoop; a man in a brown suit stands in front of a blue sofa; a girl in a yellow raincoat runs to her kneeling grandpa; a girl drives a red pedal car; a boy in striped pajamas sits under a little table that holds his bowl of soup; flowers everywhere; the open green door on the left leads back into the classroom and a small canteen with a blue door stands on the right; a wooden gate beside the chef's hut leads to the farmyard and a little gate under the pergola behind the golfer leads to the covered yard.

doors.label: L'école
doors.hint: Back through the green door into the classroom

doors.label: La cantine
doors.hint: Through the blue door to the school canteen

doors.label: La basse-cour
doors.hint: Through the wooden gate by the chef's hut to the farmyard

doors.label: Le préau
doors.hint: Through the little gate behind the golfer to the covered yard

cantine.name: La cantine · School Canteen
cantine.alt: The school canteen painted in ink and gouache, wooden floorboards and a big red woven rug: a butler in a tailcoat bows and steps aside so two grannies get the best view from the window; a girl switches on a glowing standing lamp; a boy at an easel paints a portrait of himself, a little mirror beside him; a girl rings a big brass hand bell; two friends at a little table share one bowl, each slurping an end of one long noodle; a boy holds up his wooden toy horse with a thumbs-up; a man with shaving suds on his cheeks shaves himself at a mirror and washbasin; a little girl holds out a teddy bear to you; long tables, benches and pans on the dresser; the open blue door on the left leads back to the school garden.

doors.label: Le jardin de l'école
doors.hint: Back through the blue door to the school garden

preau.name: Le préau · Covered Yard
preau.alt: The school's covered yard on a pouring wet afternoon, painted in ink and gouache: under the timber roof a grandpa in a flat cap sits on a plump red cushion with a little soccer player beside him and a cobweb by his ball; a girl reaches up to swing the gold pendulum of the post clock while two friends lean against the post; the caretaker vacuums and mops a puddle beside a barefoot boy whose shoes lie on the dry floor; the snack cart with its milk churn and cups waits by the back wall. Out in the rain, people hurry in from a blue van under umbrellas, a man with an umbrella in front and a little boy in green running between them; a small green garden gate on the left leads back to the school garden.

doors.label: Le jardin de l'école
doors.hint: Back through the little green gate to the school garden

zooms.label: le goûter
zooms.hint: Look closely at the snack cart

basse_cour.name: La basse-cour · Farmyard
basse_cour.alt: The school farmyard at morning feeding and milking time, painted in ink and gouache: a whitewashed barn wall with an open garden gate on the left, the big wooden barn at the back and a hen house on stilts with a ramp on the right. A milkmaid milks a brown-and-white cow that turns to moo while a farm boy holds up a milk pitcher and points at himself; a farmer's wife kneels by an open cellar hatch and points at a sack of potatoes as a girl leans in; a straw-hatted grandpa with a saw hands his bucket to little Louie in a red sweater; a boy runs up lifting an eel from his water bucket; a boy pushes a barrow heaped far too high with turnips while a girl shades her eyes and points over to the hen house.

doors.label: Le jardin de l'école
doors.hint: Back through the open gateway to the school garden

zooms.label: le poulailler
zooms.hint: Look closely at the hen house

poulailler.name: Le poulailler · Hen House
poulailler.alt: Close-up in front of the farmyard hen house at egg-collecting time: hens tumble down the ramp on the left while a girl in yellow toots a tin whistle to call them, a tiny curly-haired girl in red puts a hand on her chest and blows a kiss, Ryan in blue overalls holds out an empty nest, and a girl kneeling in the straw points at one brown egg beside her knee.

bibliotheque.name: La bibliothèque · Library
bibliotheque.alt: The school library at book-choosing hour, painted in ink and gouache from a high view of the whole room: tall pale-wood bookcases line the walls, lamps hang from the white ceiling and cool daylight pours through the tall window on the left; a boy and his sister press their noses to a kelp aquarium where a seahorse hides, while a little girl runs up holding a plush koala; a girl on the rolling library ladder looks along the shelves with a little brown owl perched on top; on the round green rug two boys kneel over a heap of model-kit pieces and an open craft book, one throwing up his hands, and beside them a boy holds up his picture book; at her desk the librarian holds up a big golden key while a boy reads, a boy beside her turns out his empty pockets, and at the little side table a girl combs jelly beans into rows next to the guessing jar; floor cushions and an empty book cart stand on the oak floor, and an open arched door shows the red curtains and seats of the school theater.

doors.label: Le théâtre de l'école
doors.hint: Back through the open door to the school theater

fete.name: La fête de l'école · School Fête
fete.alt: The school fête painted in ink and gouache in a sunny courtyard under bunting, a natural crowd scene: on the left a cake table where children and a cook serve from a wooden cart; a granny on a bench fans herself while a small boy and his dad read picture comics side by side in the same pose; children dance round a tall white maypole with ribbons, one girl reaching up to it; a girl swings on a rope swing from the big plane tree; in the foreground a little boy holds out a huge gold prize cup to show a girl who hugs a plush quokka; a little further back a girl offers a gray pony hay and a carrot while her friend, seen from behind, holds a tin-can telephone to her ear, and a smiling busker in patches fiddles for the pony beside his empty hat; an open door at the back shows the red curtains of the school theater.

doors.label: Le théâtre de l'école
doors.hint: Back through the open door to the school theater

zooms.label: la table des gâteaux
zooms.hint: Look closely at the cake table

gateaux.name: La table des gâteaux · Cake Table
gateaux.alt: Close-up of the fête's cake table on the lawn under bunting: a boy with a bandaged knee sits at the end, a girl whisks batter in a big bowl, a mom holds a cookie jar high above a boy and his toy blocks, a red lobster snaps its claws beside a ringing alarm clock, a little ant in a baker's toque stands by a slice of cake and a boy in stripes points across from the chocolate cake.

tableau.name: Le tableau · The Alphabet Blackboard
tableau.alt: Close-up of the classroom blackboard in its wooden frame: the 26 letters of the alphabet, A to Z, written in white chalk in five neat rows, with a felt eraser and two sticks of chalk on the ledge.

gouter.name: Le goûter · Snack Cart
gouter.alt: Close-up of the covered yard's green snack cart at snack time while the rain pours past the roof edge: the moustached dinner man pours orange juice right up to the brim of a boy's cup, a girl pours cocoa from a pitcher for her granny, who waits on a low stool, a girl holds out two slices of bread and jam, and a small boy peeks out from behind the big silver dairy churn on the cart.
